gloss: finishing beautifully; ending on a high note; crowning glory

definitions.gloss: finishing beautifully; ending on a high note; a fitting conclusion
definitions.explanation: A beautiful or admirable ending to an endeavor, career, or event. Emphasizes that the final result or conclusion was worthy and impressive.

examples.japanese: {有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: He finished beautifully in his retirement match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧、{有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}りたい→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make the last project a success and end on a high note.

notes:
An expression meaning to bring something to a beautiful or admirable conclusion. {有終|ゆうしゅう} means "having a [good] end" and ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ means "beauty." Often used for careers, competitions, or long-term endeavors.

USAGE:
Almost always appears in the fixed phrase {有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (literally "to decorate with the beauty of a fine ending"). Rarely used in other constructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to finish beautifully, to end on a high note
- {有終|ゆうしゅう}の{美|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}れなかった→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: could not finish beautifully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花道|はなみち}→花道：14009_hanamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to make a splendid exit (literally "to decorate the flower path")
- {大団円|だいだんえん}: grand finale, happy ending
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to cap off the end

ETYMOLOGY:
From classical Chinese. The concept comes from the idea that what matters most is how something ends, not just how it begins.
